_comment: Hand-editable placement for gen_pcb.py.  x, y = centre of the footprint courtyard in mm
from the board's top-left corner (x right, y down); rot in degrees (KiCad sense, 90 turns
a vertical DIP horizontal, counter-clockwise on screen); side = top|bottom.  Parts not
listed are placed automatically next to the part named in their PcbNear schematic field
Every part here is placed with its SOCKET footprint.  Hand-placed
courtyards that collide are an error, not a warning (allow_overlap: true per part to accept
one).  checks.sockets demands a socket footprint for every DIP/PLCC part, checks.zif (optional) a
ZIF footprint for the listed refs.  A part may carry keepout: [[x0, y0, x1, y1, why], ...]
in footprint-local mm (unrotated, y down): each becomes a KiCad rule area that forbids
other footprints (DRC reports intruders) and that the auto-placer avoids.
Floorplan rev C2 (front = bottom edge of the sheet, back = top edge): CPLD2 (I/O) left of centre, CPLD1 (bus and
memory) right next to the SRAM pair (top right) and the two 74AHCT245 bus buffers; CPU horizontal below both
CPLDs; the two flash chips (plain DIP-32 sockets) stand vertically at the right edge next to the CPU's end.
Back edge: J1 USB-C, J2 FTDI A, J11 FTDI B, J5 RCA, J10 S-video, J7 JTAG; the AD724 video section sits under
its two jacks. Front edge: J3 PS/2, J6 audio, J4 microSD (with the 3.3 V LDO behind it), then SW1 reset and
SW2 NMI with the three LEDs (D5 power, D3 LED0, D4 LED1) behind them, so a case can expose them. J9 (logic

the CPU carries the silkscreen dedication. J9 (logic analyzer, 2x15) and J7 (JTAG) stand on the left edge with the six series arrays RN1-RN6 in a spaced column beside J9 (the auto-placer jammed them into the corner and the router could not finish there); the
DUART and its crystal keep the left-centre.
